channel.title: Mythwake News
channel.description: News and patch notes for Mythwake, an online 2D RPG.

item.title: Loot Bags - Follow Me, Party Play and Smoother Chat
item.description:
Every kill now drops one loot bag only you can see, follow your friends across the map, a new face in Guild Row, a bigger reward for fighting together, and a lot of polish: chat that behaves, fishing that tells you when the fish move, and smoother menus on a controller. The game closes for a minute during the update, with a countdown first; Microsoft Store players get it through the Store, and the launcher downloads only what changed. Thanks for every report: keep them coming through Menu > Report a bug or the Discord.

Highlights

  • Loot bags. Each kill drops one bag that only you (or your party) can see. Open all your nearby bags at once in one small window, take what you want or everything, and keep fighting while it's open.
  • Follow a player. Right-click a player and pick Follow to walk after them.
  • Registrar Kerensa in Guild Row. Found a guild, manage yours, or ask what guilds are for.
  • Train near your level. Monsters pay for their health, so the best XP is on monsters close to your level.
  • Party play pays more. Fighting together gives a bigger XP bonus to everyone who's pitching in.
  • Chat that gets out of your way. It lets go of the keyboard after you send, and no longer sticks on a whisper.

Read the full notes

item.title: Microsoft Store Launch! - Bosses Bite Back
item.description:
Mythwake is on the Microsoft Store! Download it straight from the Store, no launcher needed, and the Store keeps it up to date for you: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NCS6GLQ56GV (every way to play: https://playmythwake.com/download). Already using the launcher? It keeps working as before.

Bosses hit harder and smarter, boss drops are worth chasing, and armour fits better. The game closes for a minute during the update, with a countdown first; Store players get it through the Store, and the launcher downloads only what changed. Thanks for every report: keep them coming through Menu > Report a bug or the Discord.

Highlights

  • Bosses hit like their level. The higher the boss, the harder it hits.
  • No more frozen bosses. A boss that can't reach you walks round what's in the way, leaps to you, or gives up and walks home.
  • Boss drops build a set. Bosses drop helms, gloves, boots, rings and earrings any combat style can wear, plus their own weapons, with new pieces to find.
  • Armour fits better. Dozens of pieces are redrawn or refitted.
  • A tidier skill guide. Armour sets are one row each, and gear says where it comes from.

Read the full notes

item.title: Calmer Packs, Free Bolts
item.description:
Mages' basic bolts are free, packs no longer all come at you at once, and crafting materials come from where you'd expect. The game closes for a short while during the update; the launcher downloads it as soon as it opens again. Thanks for every report: keep them coming through Menu > Report a bug or the Discord.

Highlights

  • Free basic bolts. A staff's or wand's basic bolt costs no MP (was 1).
  • Packs no longer all come at once. Monsters stand in loners and small groups, and only a few of a pack notice you as you walk past: 1 of a group of 3 (was all 3). Hit one standing in a group and its packmates join in; a loner fights alone.
  • See a monster's level before you fight. Monsters near you show their level and name, coloured from grey (far below you) through green, yellow and orange to red (far above). Your target's name turns purple.
  • Bosses can't be fought from safety. Hit a boss from a spot it can't reach and it leaps next to you. Where it can't land, your hits miss and it heals until you come out.
  • New sources for cloth. Scarecrows on Scarecrow Hill near Wheatlow and in Pellow's Practice Yard drop 1-2 Flax, woven into Linen Cloth. Downs Sheep on Hollin Downs drop a Fleece, woven into Wool Cloth, and Raw Mutton to cook.
  • Crafting starts quicker. The first levels of Forging, Woodworking and Tailoring come faster: a Copper bar pays 9 Forging XP (was 6), so a Copper Platebody gives 45 XP (was 30). Every piece of a tier can be made by the level you can wear it: every Iron piece by Forging 20 (the Iron Platebody was 29).

Read the full notes

item.title: Monsters Fight Back
item.description:
Monsters are harder to cheese and quests show up on your maps. Thanks to everyone who reported what felt off. Keep the reports coming through Menu > Report a bug.

There's a new launcher. Download it from https://playmythwake.com/download and use it in place of the old one: it shows when the game is under maintenance and has the new look.

Highlights

  • Stronger monsters pay more XP. One-hitting a Lv 1 no longer pays like fighting something your own level.
  • Quest markers. A gold "?" on the minimap and world map shows where each quest goes next.
  • Monsters fight back. Packs hit much harder, and a monster that gives up the chase keeps its wounds.
  • A new look. A barber and a clothier have opened in Tolvadden, with eight new hairstyles.
  • Fish and feast. Fishing has its own net and rod animations, and animals drop meat to cook: six new foods from Cooking 1 to 30.
  • Crafting is a real climb. Forging, Woodworking, Tailoring and Alchemy pay by the materials you use and take several times longer to level.
